description: This Kotlin source file defines the HomeFragment class, a user interface component for displaying prayer times, checklist status, and Qibla compass preview in an Islamic prayer companion app. It manages data loading, UI updates, and navigation to other activities such as prayer history and Qibla compass.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that manages the home screen UI, including prayer times display, countdown to next prayer, prayer checklist, and Qibla compass preview.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the UI components, sets up event listeners, and starts data initialization and UI updates.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches prayer times data, updates the UI, and schedules notifications. Handles loading, success, and failure states.

methods.name: updateHeader
methods.description: Updates the header text with current date and time.

methods.name: updateNextPrayer
methods.description: Finds and displays the next upcoming prayer based on current time.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Starts periodic UI updates and Qibla compass, refreshes data upon resuming.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Stops UI updates and compass when fragment is paused.
